plan: DUMMIE PLAN V1 — Cognitive Evolution Operating Layer

claims: A minimal world model can replace repeated raw-repo reconstruction for global orientation.
Global correctness requires canonical phase state plus truth and polyglot contracts.
Context must be compact, structured, and anti-bias to remain reusable.
objections: Reports alone are stale-prone and cannot act as primary truth.
Phase state and registry drift can invalidate cached summaries.
Python-heavy code volume can still bias global summaries if polyglot registry is skipped.
decisions: Use world model JSON/MD as compact canonical orientation layer.
Mark current/next phase as dynamic files that must be reloaded each run.
Require polyglot registry and truth schema for global tasks.
Block bulk loading of raw memory/vault artifacts by default.
risks: World model freshness drift if not regenerated after canonical source changes.
Coverage confidence remains uneven until P8 establishes measurable gates.
L6 first-party UI confidence remains low in current evidence.

snowball_assessment.reason: P7 compresses validated governance and architecture truth into a reusable canonical context source for future phases.

warnings: Known legacy spec debt remains in doc/guides/mcp_server_usage.md.
Coverage linkage quality is not yet gate-enforced until P8.
World model must be regenerated when canonical inputs change.
